stage: implementation-only frozen BiomedCLIP saliency smoke test
supervision: train images and binary image-level labels only; no annotations or validation/test images

tumor: A bone radiograph showing a bone tumor.
An x-ray image with a bone neoplasm.
An x-ray image showing an abnormal bone lesion.
normal: A normal bone radiograph without a tumor.
An x-ray image of healthy bone.
An x-ray image without a bone lesion.

sample_rule: within each train binary class sort by SHA256(image_id), use first 32 for score diagnostics and first 4 for saliency
saliency: absolute gradient-times-activation over channels at frozen visual transformer block 11 norm2, tumor-prompt mean minus normal-prompt mean
scientific_scope: technical compatibility only; no validation segmentation metric and no authorization to generate train pseudo-masks
